bio: Easy 4.5 km walk along the Murray from the Pump Station on Milloo Street past many of Swan Hill's attractions.
Museum on a secret wartime flying boat repair depot, with a heritage-listed Catalina and an underground bunker.
Shepparton art museum with over 4,000 works, a large ceramics collection and the Namatjira family; entry is free.
Adventure playground on the Midland Highway at Mooroopna, with entry by gold coin donation.
gaps: Current open or closed status unconfirmed; local reports suggest decline or closure for works. Verify before adding.

bio: 48 km of walking and cycling trails linking Rutherglen with Wahgunyah, Lake Moodemere and local cellar doors.
Murray reservoir between Yarrawonga and Mulwala, formed by the 1939 weir and popular for boating, kayaking and fishing.
Heritage steam train running 25.1 km from Belgrave to Gembrook through the Dandenong Ranges on a narrow-gauge line.
gaps: Fare unconfirmed on operator page (61-64 from resellers); official site blocked.

bio: Mountain Ash forest near Melbourne, with the 1000 Steps, Olinda Falls and Sherbrooke Falls, lyrebirds and wallabies.
Cool temperate rainforest in Dandenong Ranges National Park, with a walk to Sherbrooke Falls, best after rain.
Mount Dandenong forest sanctuary of 92 ceramic sculptures among fern gullies, partly reopened after storm damage.
gaps: Some areas still closed for restoration; fee and hours unconfirmed by Parks Victoria.

bio: Olinda cool-climate garden of rhododendrons, azaleas and daffodils, with a 3.5 km circuit and Yarra Valley views.
Hilltop village 41 km east of Melbourne, gateway to Olinda Falls, the forest walks and the botanic garden.
gaps: No visitor source names the village's own draws; weak as a spot.

bio: Historic farm at Yarra Glen with Clydesdales, open only the first Thursday and last Sunday of each month.
Park below Maroondah Dam near Healesville with gardens, barbecues and the 82 Rose Steps up the dam wall.
Picnic spot near Healesville with three easy walks of 1.1 to 1.4 km to Badger Creek, known for birdlife.
gaps: Barbecue closure reported; fee not stated.

bio: Boardwalk of about 700 m return through myrtle beech and sassafras rainforest in Toolangi State Forest.
Western gateway town to the Yarra Valley and start of the Lilydale to Warburton Rail Trail along the old railway.
gaps: No visitor-oriented source names Lilydale as a place to go; borderline.

bio: Elevated platform 15 m above the forest floor in cool temperate rainforest on Mount Donna Buang near Warburton.
gaps: Sources call it Rainforest Gallery only; Skywalk in name unverified. No coordinates.

bio: Jagged ridges with views and some of Victoria's best hiking, from gentle trails to Sugarloaf Peak at 920 m.
gaps: Not part of Yarra Ranges National Park; check destination assignment.

bio: Steep marked walk to South Jawbone Peak in Cathedral Range State Park, with uneven ground and snakes.
gaps: Sits in Cathedral Range State Park, so destination assignment looks wrong; length and duration not sourced.

bio: Rainforest loop of 3.4 to 4 km near Marysville through Myrtle Beech and Mountain Ash, with lyrebirds often heard.
Giant Mountain Ash over 300 years old and about 76 m tall near Powelltown, on an easy 3.2 km return walk.
gaps: Yarra State Forest, not the national park; access road may need a key; heights vary by source.

bio: Historic aqueduct trail for walkers and cyclists, about 30 to 34 km one way from Don Valley to East Warburton.
gaps: Trail length unofficial; night access restricted for deer control.

bio: Park on the Great Dividing Range with views to Melbourne, plus Masons Falls and the Mount Sugarloaf lookout.
